name: Databricks Connector
description: Connect to a Databricks workspace for bound (not ingested) Unity Catalog discovery and governed reads. PAT or OAuth token authentication against a SQL Warehouse. Inbound only.
use_cases: Register existing Databricks tables as bound data products
Discover Unity Catalog catalogs, schemas, tables, and views
Least-privilege metadata and aggregate queries via SQL Warehouse

entity.name: Databricks
entity.description: Databricks SQL Warehouse connector for bound Unity Catalog tables. Does not ingest rows into Loxtep storage.

host.help: Databricks workspace host (e.g. dbc-xxxx.cloud.databricks.com). No https:// prefix required.

warehouse_id.help: SQL Warehouse ID used for Statement Execution API calls.

http_path.help: Optional SQL Warehouse HTTP path (e.g. /sql/1.0/warehouses/{id}). Informational; Statement Execution uses warehouse_id.

catalog.help: Optional default Unity Catalog catalog for the session.

schema.help: Optional default schema for the session.

auth_method.help: pat uses the token field; oauth uses oauth_access_token.

token.help: Personal access token (PAT). Externalized to SSM.

oauth_access_token.help: OAuth access token for workspace auth. Externalized to SSM.

statement_timeout_seconds.help: Per-statement wait timeout in seconds (5–50). Default 30.

connection_config_spec.help: Required: host, warehouse_id, plus token (PAT) or oauth_access_token.

connector_package.description: Bound Databricks / Unity Catalog source. Metadata and aggregates only; rows are not ingested into Loxtep. Customer UC remains source of truth.
follow_up_notes: Runtime: platform DatabricksConnector (native). Do not set use_catalog_runtime.
Do not declare fetch_data or push_data — Databricks is bound, not ingested.
Secrets (token, oauth_access_token) are sensitive and stored in the existing SSM connector path.
Binding field database maps to Unity Catalog catalog name.
